about: The full list without the 100-row cap: 178 goods-issued, unbilled deliveries. 144 had their goods issue on or after 1 Sep 2026 (77 of them wait for POD, 59 are 3 days old or less); 34 are legacy leftovers from 2019-2025.
underlyingRequests: GET /sap/opu/odata/sap/API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=0002/A_OutbDeliveryHeader?$filter=OverallGoodsMovementStatus eq 'C' and (OverallDelivReltdBillgStatus eq 'A' or OverallDelivReltdBillgStatus eq 'B')&$select=DeliveryDocument,SoldToParty,ShipToParty,SalesOrganization,ActualGoodsMovementDate,OverallDelivReltdBillgStatus,DeliveryBlockReason&$orderby=ActualGoodsMovementDate asc&$top=500
note: Answer of the hackathon MCP server tool (shaped JSON, not the raw OData envelope). 'underlyingRequests' are the OData calls the tool makes, so you can reproduce it with any HTTP client (add sap-client=100&$format=json).
